name: CreateServiceNowUser
label: Create ServiceNow User
description: Creates a new user in ServiceNow using a stored credential.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential
fields.description: The stored ServiceNow credential (Base64 token or OAuth2 token)

fields.name: ShortDescription
fields.label: Short Description
fields.description: Full name or display name of the user (e.g., John Doe)

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: List of key-value pairs representing additional user fields (e.g., email, phone)

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from ServiceNow API

fields.name: CreatedUser
fields.label: Created User
fields.description: The created user record as JObject

fields.name: UserId
fields.label: User ID (sys_id)
fields.description: The sys_id of the created user
